name: ParagraphFormat2
description: Represents the paragraph formatting of a text range.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an object that represents the application that contains the object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a value representing the application that created the ParagraphFormat2 object. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the parent object for the ParagraphFormat2 object. Read-only.

properties.name: Alignment
properties.description: Gets or sets a value specifying the alignment of the paragraph. Read/write.

properties.name: BaselineAlignment
properties.description: Gets or sets a constant that represents the vertical position of fonts in a paragraph. Read/write.

properties.name: Bullet
properties.description: Gets a BulletFormat2 object for the paragraph. Read-only.

properties.name: FarEastLineBreakLevel
properties.description: Gets or sets the East Asian line break control level for the specified paragraph. Read/write.

properties.name: FirstLineIndent
properties.description: Gets or sets the value (in points) for a first line or hanging indent. Read/write.

properties.name: HangingPunctuation
properties.description: Determines whether hanging punctuation is enabled for the specified paragraphs. Read/write.

properties.name: IndentLevel
properties.description: Gets or sets a value representing the indent level assigned to text in the selected paragraph. Read/write.

properties.name: LeftIndent
properties.description: Gets or sets a value that represents the left indent value (in points) for the specified paragraphs. Read/write.

properties.name: LineRuleAfter
properties.description: Determines whether line spacing after the last line in each paragraph is set to a specific number of points or lines. Read/write.

properties.name: LineRuleBefore
properties.description: Determines whether line spacing before the first line in each paragraph is set to a specific number of points or lines. Read/write.

properties.name: LineRuleWithin
properties.description: Determines whether line spacing between base lines is set to a specific number of points or lines. Read/write.

properties.name: RightIndent
properties.description: Gets or sets the right indent (in points) for the specified paragraphs. Read/write.

properties.name: SpaceAfter
properties.description: Gets or sets the amount of spacing (in points) after the specified paragraph. Read/write.

properties.name: SpaceBefore
properties.description: Gets or sets the spacing (in points) before the specified paragraphs. Read/write.

properties.name: SpaceWithin
properties.description: Gets or sets the amount of space between base lines in the specified paragraph, in points or lines. Read/write.

properties.name: TabStops
properties.description: Gets a TabStops2 collection that represents all the custom tab stops for the specified paragraphs. Read-only.

properties.name: TextDirection
properties.description: Gets or sets the text direction for the specified paragraph. Read/write.

properties.name: WordWrap
properties.description: Determines whether the application wraps the Latin text in the middle of a word in the specified paragraphs. Read/write.
